identityAssessment.finding: The imported feature covers the Ecuador-Peru Amazon region, approximately 77.65 to 74.26 degrees west and 5.17 to 1.78 degrees south. The subject is Achuar communities, not the broader Jivaroan family or the distinct Shuar people. Exact imported boundaries are unverified.

scopeNotes: Most pottery in the Spurlock Whitten collection is Canelos Quichua, not Achuar. Only the specifically attributed gong is used.
Neither the pottery exhibition nor the Jea documentation is presented as an archaeological excavation.
Kew’s interpretation of medicinal knowledge is not a claim of pharmaceutical safety or efficacy.
The research dates of 2011 and 2024 remain distinct from later publication dates.
Peruvian historical phases do not establish identical events in all Ecuadorian communities.
